items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: You said you met him on Beale Street once.

ctx.x: No one didn't want it. No one wanted them. Now it's just a reverse today. You go in a music store, you'll ask Albert's system to think insane. What are you speaking about? We don't use nothing like that. If you go and show them one for a trip, no, we'll take that thing and throw it in the trash pile. Just a reverse.
So he played nice Papatio, huh?
